observations: Manifest component identity must be verified separately from payload equality because cross-component replay is a distinct failure mode.
Frozen request bytes remain the replay authority; current source clocks govern only newly minted semantic boundaries.
Learn needs the post-task snapshot in its request payload to participate in the same source-bound context contract.
State-only heartbeat commits can safely advance main during exact-head CI when the result branch does not modify the lease file; a fresh mergeability check remains mandatory.
reason: The bounded implementation and publication unit passed without evidence justifying a prompt Candidate or global activation; Task Evaluate and dispatch-time revocation work remain required.
